statusVocabulary.implemented: opy-rs production behavior is implemented for the stated leaf.
statusVocabulary.partial: Only the stated slice is implemented; limits are mandatory.
statusVocabulary.unsupported: The leaf is explicitly outside the current opy-rs contract.
statusVocabulary.external-owner: The behavior belongs to an owning repository boundary.
statusVocabulary.unclear: The pinned surface is recorded but implementation/evidence is not yet resolved.

coverageVocabulary.covered: Executable evidence exercises the stated leaf contract.
coverageVocabulary.partial: Evidence covers a bounded slice and names its limits.
coverageVocabulary.uncovered: No opy-rs executable leaf evidence is claimed.
